checks: The §1 finite sum remains positive. Differentiating the normalized probabilities gives p_z(z−m) and −p_z(|z|²−E|z|²)/2, and differentiating once more gives the stated centered Hessian after terms proportional to E(g−G) cancel.
The trace of the centered Hessian is Cov(g,|z−m|²). Expanding |z|² about m cancels this trace and the posterior-mean drift against ∂tG.

The independent Gaussian increments under a fixed hidden base produce the product likelihood exp(A_t·z−t|z|²/2). Nested partitions containing t give the same posterior after taking their dense union and using continuity and bounded conditional expectation convergence.

The posterior mean is a bounded martingale. The conditional increment of A on [s,t] equals (t−s)m_s, and so does that of ∫m. The innovation is a continuous martingale with bracket tI and is Brownian in the observation filtration. Itô yields both bounded SDE martingales.

Section §2 uses a fixed mark and cap coefficients in [0,1] including pure-base boundaries. Conditional Jensen applies to the Lipschitz concave infimum. Each through-mark closed cap mass is upper semicontinuous in the mark, so taking an infimum and maximizing over the compact actual set justifies attainment and the maximum's Lipschitz constant.

The source specializes π to fiber-volume proportions on a compatible lattice-complete base. The frozen extension to a finite real base and arbitrary positive prior uses only Bayes, fixed conditional laws and a compact marked union, so no compatibility is required for these conclusions.

overlap.comparison: This accepted fact conditions a lattice Gaussian on equal parity and factors midpoint and displacement laws. Its variables are static lattice samples and it contains neither an observation filtration nor mixed halfspace-depth martingales.

readability: The scope and notation are explicit in the frozen statement and proof.
review_method: Independent cold read of exact frozen input, original-source and declared dependency audit, search for accepted overlap, direct mathematical checks and exact arithmetic where applicable.
summary: The finite posterior derivatives, observation-filtration martingales and fixed-mark depth inequality follow with the original conditional fiber laws and closed cap convention.
